subject.title: Logbook: automatic work journal plugin with Control UI timeline tab

question: Should Logbook land as a bundled disabled-by-default OpenClaw plugin after the linked PR blockers are fixed, or should this screen-capture workflow stay external until the privacy and plugin-API policy is settled?
rationale: The request combines periodic screen capture, retained local frames, model-bound analysis, new plugin configuration, and Control UI surface area, so code inspection alone cannot decide the product and security boundary.

options.title: Land bundled after blockers and security approval
options.body: Fix the linked PR's structured-model and scope/security blockers, then merge only after maintainers accept the disabled-by-default privacy model and plugin tab contract.

options.title: Move to external plugin path
options.body: Keep core lean by having Logbook ship through ClawHub or an external plugin repository unless a missing core API is identified.

options.title: Split API/security prework first
options.body: Keep this feature issue open but require narrower prerequisite issues for plugin tab API, node-command policy, retention, and model-analysis consent before revisiting bundling.

recommendation.title: Land bundled after blockers and security approval
recommendation.body: Fix the linked PR's structured-model and scope/security blockers, then merge only after maintainers accept the disabled-by-default privacy model and plugin tab contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the feature sponsor, linked PR author, and recent adjacent contributor on Control UI/Gateway surfaces.
